name: Souma Takashi
source:
Year: 2nd Year
Special Skill: Kendo
Favorite Subject: Physical Education
Favorite Foods: Yakisoba, fruits
Favorite Words: Carrying out original intention!

A classmate of the heroine. Cheerful and active, he takes action immediately due to his curiosity. With his motto ‘carrying out original intention’, single minded he basically has a serious personality, from around him he has a trust that is deep. As soon as he gets along with the heroine, he will show her many things about the school. He has no ulterior motive, he is the type that is genuinely nice to people. Probably because of his nature, regardless of gender he has a lot of friends. His facial expressions seem to change very often.
